sum: Genenta Science S.p.A. operates as a strategic consolidator that focuses on acquiring ownership of privately held companies operating in Italian national-security-regulated sectors. Its activities and acquisition strategy covers aerospace, defense, national security, and biotechnology/biosecurity. Genenta Science S.p.A. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Milan, Italy.
ceo: Mr. Pierluigi  Paracchi (Co-Founder, Chairman, CEO & GM)
